title: Fried Mantou with Buttermilk Sauce
title_ms: Roti Mantou Goreng dengan Sos Buttermilk
description: Crispy fried mini mantou buns served with a creamy, garlicky buttermilk sauce made with curry leaf, cheese and evaporated milk.
description_ms: Roti mantou mini yang digoreng garing dicicah dengan sos buttermilk yang creamy, berkari daun dan berkeju.
steps: Chop 4 garlic cloves and 3 bird's eye chillies.
Sauté in 1 tbsp butter until slightly soft; add 2 stalks curry leaf and stir briefly.
Pour in 0.5 can evaporated milk; add a small amount of chicken stock cube (not too much — it will be salty).
Add 0.5 tbsp sweetened condensed milk and 2 slices processed cheese; stir until the cheese melts into a creamy sauce.
Meanwhile, fry the frozen mini mantou buns in hot oil until golden brown on all sides.
Serve the mantou hot with the buttermilk sauce for dipping.
steps_ms: Chop 4 ulas bawang putih dan 3 biji cili padi.
Tumis dalam 1 sudu besar butter sehingga layu sikit; masukkan 2 tangkai daun kari dan kacau sebentar.
Tuang setengah tin susu cair; masukkan sedikit kiub pati ayam (jangan banyak — nanti masin).
Masukkan setengah sudu besar susu pekat manis dan 2 keping cheese; kacau sehingga cheese cair menjadi sos yang creamy.
Sementara itu, goreng roti mantou mini beku dalam minyak panas sehingga golden brown semua sisi.
Hidang mantou panas-panas bersama sos buttermilk untuk dicicah.
